en: A sepia-toned panoramic view of a historic European spa town nestled in a valley with hills in the background. Dense multi‑story buildings with ornate facades line a narrow river or canal flanked by promenades and colonnades. Larger hotel-like structures stand on the slopes to the left, while rocky hillside and scattered trees appear on the right. At the top left is printed text in German reading 'Karlsbad. Blick vom Stadtgarten.' indicating the scene is a view from the city garden.
